title: TUI answers can file an adj ask and decide
lead: Owner decision #45: an optional toggle files the owner's answer as an adj ask plus decide. The recording must use decide --by jon, and only from the owner's answer in the TUI. Depends on the answer pane slice.

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: Owner decision #45: an optional toggle files the owner's answer as an adj ask plus decide. The recording must use decide --by jon, and only from the owner's answer in the TUI. Depends on the answer pane slice.

sections.heading: Files
sections.body: - internal/tui (toggle), internal/daemon or cli (the adj calls), tests, docs.

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
- TestAnswerFilesAdjAskAndDecideWhenToggled: with the toggle on, the daemon runs adj check, then adj ask (if not open), then adj decide with the answer text and --why, then resumes the role.
- TestAnswerSkipsAskWhenKeyIsOpenOrDecided: when adj check reports open or decided, adj ask does not run.
- TestAnswerWithToggleOffRecordsNothingInAdj: with the toggle off, no adj call runs.
- TestAnswerAdjErrorKeepsTextAndDoesNotResume: an adj error shows its code and message verbatim, the typed text stays, and engine.Answer is not called.
- TestAdjCallsLandInWrites: each adj call adds an entry to the run's writes[] with Tool "adj".

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
1. Write the failing tests first (the Failing-tests above): in internal/adjcli/adjcli_test.go with fixtures, and in internal/daemon/runs_test.go with a fake adj runner. Run them and confirm they fail.
2. internal/adjcli/adjcli.go: add three calls to Client (today it has only Inbox :82 and List :88): Check (adj check QUERY; the first output line is decided, open, closed or not found; exit 0 for all four), Ask (adj ask TITLE with --option, --recommend, --ref ITEM, --context, --by), and Decide (adj decide ID --text ANSWER --why WHY --by NAME).
3. The writes go through runrec.Writer as slicer does: see slicercli/write.go:102-110 (runrec.Cmd with Tool "slicer"). The adj calls use Tool "adj" so they land in writes[] (runrec/record.go:151-161).
4. Add a toggle field to RunAction (runs.go:42-46) and carry it through client.go Answer (:139-141), tui/daemon.go Answer (:77-84) and the answer verb (tui/model.go:569-586).
5. daemon/runs.go answer path (:351-361): with the toggle on, before the engine call at :361, run adj check on the question (AdjRoot is proj.Path, engine.go:203). If the key is not open, run adj ask with --ref = the run's item. Then run adj decide with --text ANSWER and --why.
6. Only after both adj calls succeed, call r.engine.Answer (engine.go:287-314). If an adj call fails, return its error from ownerRun (:314-399) and do not resume.
7. The TUI keeps the typed text when the call fails (pane.go:48-80 and the answer field).
8. Pass --by explicitly on ask and decide. adj decide defaults to $ADJ_DECIDED_BY, and a detached daemon may not have it (adj decide --help; the same default applies to adj ask, $ADJ_ASKED_BY).
9. Update docs/dashboard.md:169-174 and docs/state.md (writes list).

Open: (a) the --by name (the item says jon, but the owner has not confirmed; adj key owner.questions-filing is not asked yet). (b) The reason text for --why. (c) Which key the TUI shows for the adj question: no record field holds one today (runrec.Question, record.go:103-110, has no key).

sections.heading: Check
sections.body:
- go test -race -count=1 ./...
- go vet ./...
- gofmt -l .
- go test ./internal/tui -update, then review the answer-pane goldens (pane-question-mono-*.txt) for the toggle line.
- Run TestAnswer* and TestAdj* by name with go test -run.
- The tests use fake adj runners and fixtures only. No test may run adj ask or adj decide against a real repo.
- slicer check
- adj lint
- [HUMAN CHECK] The owner answers one question with the toggle on in a test project and checks the adjudicate record.
